title: server.hello.ack
description: Reply to the client hello: negotiated protocol_version, the STT mode the backend chose and the agreed clock offset. An incompatible MAJOR gets no hello.ack; the socket is closed with a message naming both versions.

protocol_version.description: The version both sides speak: the shared MAJOR with the lower MINOR.

stt_mode.description: client: send transcript.client.* segments; server: stream binary audio frames instead (ADR-0008).

audio_format.description: The audio to stream; present exactly when stt_mode is server.

clock_offset_ms.description: Backend clock minus the client_time_ms of hello; add it to a client time to get backend time. May be negative.

server_time_ms.description: Backend clock, Unix epoch ms, when the message was sent.

vocabulary_hints.description: Since 1.4: the session's vocabulary hints (subject and topic names, concepts the observer extracted), most important first, for a client-side recognizer that accepts phrase hints. Left out when there are none, and for a client that negotiated 1.3 or lower.
